title: Willow & Statlander: friendship shattered
summary: Willow’s TBS title loss is followed by betrayal from Statlander and Stokely Hathaway.

chapters.title: Willow wins the TBS title
chapters.result: Willow defeats Julia Hart for the championship.
chapters.context: The victory gives her a title to defend against Mercedes Moné.

chapters.title: Statlander turns on Willow
chapters.result: After Willow loses to Moné, Statlander attacks her.
chapters.context: A friendship becomes a grudge as Statlander sides with Stokely.

chapters.title: Chicago Street Fight
chapters.context: The former friends settle this chapter in a no-disqualification fight.
